study type: Secondary analysis of a cohort study
exposure: Gestational age at first prenatal visit
outcome: Intrapartum acidemia (lactate greater than 4.8 mmol/L at fetal scalp blood sampling)
cohort: 1070 women in labor who underwent fetal scalp blood sampling at Karolinska University Hospital Stockholm Sweden between February 2009 and February 2011
finding: Minor language barriers, active pushing, and short maternal stature were identified as significant risk factors for intrapartum acidemia.
birth_weight: Measured as a proxy for intrauterine growth restriction
